scope: Package 2 Step O; SSE authorization/lifecycle, replay cursor, bounded buffering, client parsing and reconnect safety.

backend.authorization: Authenticated actor type/id must match the requested stream actor; replay and live subscription remain actor-scoped.
backend.backpressure: One SSE frame per response.write; queue bounded while writeBackpressured; resume on response drain; close with a safe resync control event if queue limits are exceeded.
backend.lifecycle: response close, request aborted and response error cleanup listeners are attached before awaiting durable replay.

clientAdapters.behavior: Only parsed non-array JSON objects are delivered; malformed frames are discarded with generic error; valid SSE id updates/persists cursor; seen IDs are dropped before cursor mutation.
Same safe parsing and cursor rules as unified reference.

Malformed/non-object JSON frames are discarded; cursor only advances after valid object parse; duplicate SSE IDs are dropped.

controls.title: Protected mount
controls.required: Realtime router is mounted after appAuth and actorIdentity middleware.

controls.title: Actor identity binding
controls.required: Requested actor type/id must equal the actor bound to the authenticated session.

controls.title: Actor-scoped event source
controls.required: Durable replay and live subscription both receive the same authenticated actor target.

controls.title: Cursor input validation
controls.required: Nonempty Last-Event-ID is restricted to bounded stable identifier characters; invalid values are rejected.

controls.title: Replay/live race control
controls.required: Subscribe before awaiting replay; buffer live events; deduplicate IDs while sending replay then live events.

controls.title: Replay gap response
controls.required: Gap instructs client to perform authoritative state resync and uses no sensitive payload.

controls.title: SSE response cache/security headers
controls.required: Private no-store and nosniff headers are sent before streaming.

controls.title: Response lifecycle cleanup
controls.required: close/aborted/error listeners attach before async replay; timers and subscriptions are cleaned on termination.

controls.title: Bounded backpressure
controls.required: Response writes are single-frame; pending live queue has a limit; drain resumes; overload closes with safe resync control.

controls.title: Heartbeat under backpressure
controls.required: Heartbeats do not add writes while the response is backpressured.

controls.title: Payload minimization
controls.required: Realtime service recursively drops sensitive keys and caps payload depth, key count, arrays, strings and total bytes.

controls.title: Mobile frame parsing
controls.required: All four mobile client copies parse valid non-array JSON objects before cursor mutation and never forward malformed raw frames.

controls.title: Web frame parsing/dedup
controls.required: Admin Web discards malformed/non-object JSON and duplicate event IDs; cursor advances only after parse.

controls.title: Runtime proof deferred
controls.required: Do not claim socket, reconnect, replay ordering, backpressure or authorization runtime tests passed in this static phase.

finalPhysicalTests: Authenticated actor receives only its own event audience; forged actorType/actorId is denied.
Client disconnects while durable replay is pending; listener and heartbeat are cleaned.
Client disconnects immediately after headers; no long-lived subscription remains.
Reconnect with a valid Last-Event-ID replays events in order and does not apply duplicates.
Malformed, oversized and unsupported Last-Event-ID values are rejected safely.
Replay gap produces an authoritative snapshot-resync path.
SSE response uses private no-store and nosniff headers.
Slow consumer crosses writable high-water mark; queue is bounded and drains in order.
Queue reaches maximum and stream terminates with safe resync behavior.
Malformed and non-object mobile SSE data never reaches app state or persisted cursor.
Admin Web malformed/non-object and duplicate event frames are discarded.
Event payloads cannot expose OTPs/tokens/payment or KYC sensitive fields by key.
Process restart/outbox publication and replay ordering recover without silent gaps.
knownResidualsRequiringFinalReview: Set and validate per-actor/per-session concurrent stream caps and idle timeout policy.
Audit every event schema for sensitive values encoded under non-sensitive field names; key-name redaction alone is not a semantic privacy review.
Verify durable outbox transaction atomicity, publisher retry/order and retention policy against local PostgreSQL in the final phase.
